headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles made two notable moves, transferring left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort and acquiring right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. 

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. The Arizona Diamondbacks' Zac Gallen was placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, while the Texas Rangers' Chris Martin is dealing with right shoulder impingement. The Cincinnati Reds' Nick Lodolo has a blister on his left index finger, and the Miami Marlins' William Kempner has a right elbow sprain. The Milwaukee Brewers' Brandon Woodruff was transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation, and the Atlanta Braves' Mike Yastrzemski is out with left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins' Anthony Banda was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left lat strain.

The MLB trade market has been active, with the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers received shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros, while the Chicago White Sox traded left-hander Brandon Eisert and first baseman Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for left-hander Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired right-hander Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
